40020712.author: पदार्थः
40020712.content: सः he (Yama), तस्य his (Ravana's), तु indeed, महानादम् great roar, श्रुत्वा having heard, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), प्रभुः the lord, शत्रुम् the enemy, विजयिनम् victorious, मेने considered, स्वबलस्य of his own army, च and, सङ्क्षयम् destruction.

40020712.author: Translation
40020712.content: Having heard that great roar, Lord Yama considered the enemy victorious and his own army destroyed.

40020713.author: पदार्थः
40020713.content: सः he (Yama), हि indeed, योधान् the warriors, हतान् killed, मत्वा having considered, क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened by anger, अब्रवीत् said, त्वरितम् quickly, सूतम् to the charioteer, रथः chariot, अयम् this, उपनीयताम् be brought near.

40020713.author: Translation
40020713.content: Indeed, he (Yama), considering his warriors killed and his eyes reddened with anger, quickly told his charioteer, "Bring this chariot near."

40020714.author: पदार्थः
40020714.content: तस्य his (Yama's), सूतः charioteer, तदा then, दिव्यम् divine, उपस्थाप्य having brought near, महारथम् the great chariot, स्थितः stood, सः he (Yama), च and, महातेजाः of great splendor, हि indeed, अध्यारोहत ascended, तम् that, रथम् chariot, प्राशमुद्गरहस्तः with a spear and mace in hand, च and, मृत्युः Death, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front, स्थितः stood.

40020714.author: Translation
40020714.content: Then, his charioteer, having brought near the divine great chariot, stood ready, and Yama, of great splendor, indeed ascended that chariot, while Death, holding a spear and mace, stood before him.

40020715.author: पदार्थः
40020715.content: येन by whom, सङ्क्षिप्यते is contracted, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable, कालदण्डः the staff of Time, तु indeed, पार्श्वस्थः standing by the side, मूर्तिमान् embodied, अस्य of him, च and, अभवत् became, यमप्रहरणम् Yama's weapon, दिव्यम् divine, तेजसा with splendor, ज्वलत् blazing, अग्निमत् fiery.

40020715.author: Translation
40020715.content: The imperishable three worlds are brought to an end by him, and the staff of Time, Yama's divine, blazing, fiery weapon, appeared personified by his side.

40020716.author: पदार्थः
40020716.content: तस्य of him, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निच्छिद्राः inescapable, कालपाशाः the nooses of Time, प्रतिष्ठिताः stood.

40020716.author: Translation
40020716.content: On his sides were placed the inescapable nooses of Time.

40020717.author: पदार्थः
40020717.content: पावकस्पर्शसङ्काशः resembling the touch of fire, स्थितः stood, मूर्तश्च and embodied, मुद्गरः a mace.

40020717.author: Translation
40020717.content: An embodied mace, whose touch was like fire, also stood there.

40020718.author: पदार्थः
40020718.content: ततः then, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, क्षुब्धम् agitated, अकम्पन्त trembled, दिवौकसः the gods, कालम् Time, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथा thus, क्रुद्धम् enraged, सर्वलोकभयावहम् terrifying to all worlds.

40020718.author: Translation
40020718.content: Then, having seen Time thus enraged and terrifying to all worlds, the three worlds were agitated and the gods trembled.

40020719.author: पदार्थः
40020719.content: ततः then, प्रचोदयन् urging, सूतः the charioteer, तान् those, अश्वान् horses, रुचिरप्रभान् of beautiful splendor, प्रययौ proceeded, भीमसन्नादः with a terrible roar, यत्र where, रक्षःपतिः the lord of Rakshasas, स्थितः was situated.

40020719.author: Translation
40020719.content: Then, the charioteer, urging those brightly shining horses, proceeded with a terrible roar to where the lord of Rakshasas was situated.

40020720.author: पदार्थः
40020720.content: मुहूर्तेन in a moment, यमम् Yama, ते those, तु indeed, हयाः horses, हरिहयोपमाः resembling the horses of Indra, प्रापयन् made to reach, मनसस्तुल्याः swift as thought, यत्र where, तत् that, प्रस्तुतम् commenced, रणम् battle

40020720.author: Translation
40020720.content: In an instant, those horses, swift as thought and resembling Indra's steeds, brought Yama to the place where the battle had begun.

40020721.author: पदार्थः
40020721.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तथैव just so, विकृतम् terrifying, रथम् chariot, मृत्युसमन्वितम् accompanied by death, सचिवाः ministers, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of rakshasas, सहसा suddenly, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled in all directions

40020721.author: Translation
40020721.content: Upon seeing that terrifying chariot, which seemed to embody death itself, the ministers of Ravana immediately fled in every direction.

40020722.author: पदार्थः
40020722.content: लघुसत्त्वतया due to faint-heartedness, ते they, हि indeed, नष्टसञ्ज्ञाः having lost their senses, भयार्दिताः tormented by fear, न not, इह here, योद्धुम् to fight, समर्थाः capable, स्म are, इत्युक्त्वा having said thus, प्रययुर्दिशः fled in all directions

40020722.author: Translation
40020722.content: Overwhelmed by fear and having lost their senses due to their weak courage, they declared, "We are not capable of fighting here," and fled in all directions.

40020723.author: पदार्थः
40020723.content: सः he, तु but, तम् that, तादृशम् such a, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रथम् chariot, लोकभयावहम् terrifying to the world, न not, अक्षुभ्यत was disturbed, दशग्रीवः Ravana, न not, च and, अपि even, भयम् fear, आविशत् entered

40020723.author: Translation
40020723.content: But Ravana, upon seeing that chariot which struck terror into the world, was neither disturbed nor did fear enter his heart.

40020724.author: पदार्थः
40020724.content: सः he, तु but, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having approached, व्यसृजत् discharged, शक्तितोमरान् spears and javelins, यमः Yama, मर्माणि vital spots, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, रावणस्य of Ravana, उपकृन्तत pierced

40020724.author: Translation
40020724.content: Yama, greatly enraged, approached Ravana and hurled spears and javelins, piercing Ravana's vital spots.

40020725.author: पदार्थः
40020725.content: रावणस्तु Ravana, but, ततः then, स्वस्थः composed, शरवर्षं a rain of arrows, मुमोच released, ह indeed, तस्मिन् on that, वैवस्वतरथे chariot of Yama, तोयवर्षम् a rain of water, इव like, अम्बुदः a cloud

40020725.author: Translation
40020725.content: Ravana, having regained his composure, then released a shower of arrows upon Yama's chariot, much like a cloud pouring down rain.

40020726.author: पदार्थः
40020726.content: ततः then, महाशक्तिशरैः by arrows of great power, पात्यमानैः being struck down, महोरसि on his great chest, न not, अशक्नोत् was able, प्रतिकर्तुं to retaliate, स that, राक्षसः demon, शल्यपीडितः afflicted by arrows

40020726.author: Translation
40020726.content: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.

40020727.author: पदार्थः
40020727.content: एवं thus, नानाप्रहरणैः by various weapons, यमेन by Yama, अमित्रकर्षिणा the tormentor of enemies, सप्तरात्रं for seven nights, कृतः made, सङ्ख्ये in battle, विसञ्ज्ञः unconscious, विमुखः turned away, रिपुः the enemy

40020727.author: Translation
40020727.content: Thus, for seven nights in battle, the enemy Ravana was rendered senseless and turned away by Yama, the tormentor of foes, using various weapons.

40020728.author: पदार्थः
40020728.content: तदा then, आसीत् was, तुमुलं a tumultuous, युद्धं battle, यमराक्षसयोः between Yama and the demon, द्वयोः of the two, जयम् victory, आकाङ्क्षतोः desiring, वीर O hero, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः unyielding

40020728.author: Translation
40020728.content: Then, a fierce battle ensued between Yama and the demon, both unyielding warriors desiring victory in their fight.

40020729.author: पदार्थः
40020729.content: ततः then, देवाः the gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, प्रजापतिं Prajapati, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front, समेताः assembled, तत् that, रणाजिरम् battlefield

40020729.author: Translation
40020729.content: Then, the gods, along with Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, assembled at that battlefield, led by Prajapati Brahma.

40020730.author: पदार्थः
40020730.content: संवर्त इव like the cosmic dissolution, लोकानां of the worlds, क्रुध्यतोः of the two who were enraged, अभवत् it became, तदा then, राक्षसानां च and of the Rākṣasas, मुख्यस्य of the chief, प्रेतानाम् of the departed spirits, ईश्वरस्य च and of the lord.

40020730.author: Translation
40020730.content: Then, the battle between the chief of the Rākṣasas and the lord of the departed spirits became like the cosmic dissolution of the worlds.

40020731.author: पदार्थः
40020731.content: राक्षसेन्द्रो ऽपि the lord of Rākṣasas also, विस्फार्य having stretched, चापम् his bow, इन्द्राशनिप्रभम् shining like Indra's thunderbolt, निरन्तरम् इव as if without gaps, आकाशं the sky, कुर्वन् making, बाणान् arrows, ततः then, असृजत् he released.

40020731.author: Translation
40020731.content: The lord of Rākṣasas, drawing his bow which shone like Indra's thunderbolt, then released arrows, making the sky appear as if it had no gaps.

40020732.author: पदार्थः
40020732.content: मृत्युं Death, चतुर्भिः with four, विशिखैः sharp arrows, सूतं the charioteer, सप्तभिः with seven, आर्दयत् he afflicted, यमं Yama, शतसहस्रेण with a hundred thousand, शीघ्रं quickly, मर्मसु in the vital spots, अताडयत् he struck.

40020732.author: Translation
40020732.content: Rāvaṇa wounded Death with four sharp arrows, afflicted the charioteer with seven, and quickly struck Yama in his vital spots with a hundred thousand arrows.

40020733.author: पदार्थः
40020733.content: ततः then, क्रुद्धस्य of the enraged one, वदनात् from the face, यमस्य of Yama, समजायत arose, ज्वालामाली garlanded with flames, सनिःश्वासः with breath, सधूमः with smoke, कोपपावकः the fire of anger.

40020733.author: Translation
40020733.content: Then, from the enraged Yama's face, a fire of anger arose, garlanded with flames, accompanied by his breath and smoke.

40020734.author: पदार्थः
40020734.content: तत् that, आश्चर्यम् wonder, अथ then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवदानवसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and Dānavas, प्रहर्षितौ greatly delighted, सुसंरब्धौ greatly agitated, मृत्युकालौ Death and Kāla, बभूवतुः they became.

40020734.author: Translation
40020734.content: Then, having witnessed that marvel in the presence of gods and Dānavas, Death and Kāla became greatly delighted and exceedingly furious.

40020735.author: पदार्थः
40020735.content: ततः then, मृत्युः Death, क्रुद्धतरः more enraged, वैवस्वतम् to Vaivasvata (Yama), अभाषत spoke, मुञ्च release, माम् me, समरे in battle, यावत् until, हन्मि I kill, इमम् this, पापरक्षसम् sinful demon, न not, एषा this, रक्षः demon, भवेत् should be, अद्य today, मर्यादा a limit/boundary, हि indeed, निसर्गतः by nature/inherently

40020735.author: Translation
40020735.content: Then, Death, even more enraged, spoke to Yama, saying, "Release me in battle so that I may kill this sinful demon, for by nature, this demon should not exist today as a boundary."

40020736.author: पदार्थः
40020736.content: हिरण्यकशिपुः Hiranyakashipu, श्रीमान् glorious, नमुचिः Namuchi, शम्बरः Shambara, तथा and, विसन्धिः Visandhi, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, बलिः Bali, वैरोचनः Vairochana, अपि also, च and

40020736.author: Translation
40020736.content: The glorious Hiranyakashipu, Namuchi, Shambara, Visandhi, Dhumaketu, and Bali Vairochana were among them.

40020737.author: पदार्थः
40020737.content: दम्भुः Dambhu, दैत्यमहाराजः the great king of Daityas, वृत्रः Vritra, बाणः Bana, तथा and, एव indeed, च and, राजर्षयः royal sages, शास्त्रविदः knowers of scriptures, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, समहोरगाः along with great serpents

40020737.author: Translation
40020737.content: Dambhu, the great king of Daityas, Vritra, and Bana, along with royal sages who knew the scriptures, Gandharvas, and great serpents, were also present.

40020738.author: पदार्थः
40020738.content: ऋषयः sages, पन्नगाः serpents, दैत्याः Daityas, यक्षाः Yakshas, च and, अपि also, अप्सरोगणाः groups of Apsaras, युगान्तपरिवर्ते at the change of a Yuga (end of an age), च and, पृथिवी the earth, समहार्णवा along with great oceans

40020738.author: Translation
40020738.content: Sages, serpents, Daityas, Yakshas, and groups of Apsaras, along with the earth and its great oceans at the end of an age, were all present.

40020739.author: पदार्थः
40020739.content: क्षयम् to destruction, नीताः led/brought, महाराज O great king, सपर्वतसरिद्द्रुमाः along with mountains, rivers, and trees, एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवः many, बलवन्तः powerful, दुरासदाः difficult to approach/overcome

40020739.author: Translation
40020739.content: O great king, these and many other powerful and formidable beings, along with mountains, rivers, and trees, were all brought to destruction.

40020740.author: पदार्थः
40020740.content: विनिपन्ना fallen, मया by me, दृष्टाः seen, किमुत how much more, अयं this, निशाचरः demon.

40020740.author: Translation
40020740.content: I have seen many fallen, so what to say of this demon?

40020741.author: पदार्थः
40020741.content: मुञ्चं release, मां me, साधु properly, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, यावत् until, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I, न हि certainly not, कश्चित् anyone, मया by me, दृष्टो seen, बलवानपि even if powerful, जीवति lives.

40020741.author: Translation
40020741.content: O knower of dharma, release me so I may kill this one, for no one seen by me, however powerful, has ever lived.

40020742.author: पदार्थः
40020742.content: बलं strength, मम my, न खलु certainly not, एतत् this, मर्यादा rule, एषा this, निसर्गतः by nature, सः he, दृष्टो seen, न not, मया by me, कालं for time, मुहुर्तमापि even for a moment, जीवति lives.

40020742.author: Translation
40020742.content: This is not merely my strength, but a natural rule that anyone seen by me does not live even for a moment.

40020743.author: पदार्थः
40020743.content: तस्य his, एवं thus, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मराजः Dharmaraja, प्रतापवान् powerful, अब्रवीत् said, तत्र there, तं to him, मृत्युं to Death, त्वं you, तिष्ठ wait, एनं this one, निहन्मि I kill, अहम् I.

40020743.author: Translation
40020743.content: Having heard his words, the powerful Dharmaraja then said to Death, "You wait, I will kill this one."

40020744.author: पदार्थः
40020744.content: ततः then, संरक्तनयनः with blood-red eyes, क्रुद्धो enraged, वैवस्वतः Yama, प्रभुः lord, कालदण्डम् the rod of time/death, अमोघं unfailing, तु indeed, तोलयामास lifted, पाणिना with his hand.

40020744.author: Translation
40020744.content: Then, the enraged Lord Yama, with blood-red eyes, indeed lifted his unfailing rod of death with his hand.

40020745.author: पदार्थः
40020745.content: यस्य whose, पार्श्वेषु on the sides, निखिला all, कालपाशाः nooses of Death, प्रतिष्ठिताः are established, पावकाशनिसङ्काशो like fire and lightning, मुद्गरो a mace, मूर्तिमान् embodied, स्थितः stands.

40020745.author: Translation
40020745.content: On whose sides all the nooses of Death are established, and an embodied mace, resembling fire and lightning, stands.

40020746.author: पदार्थः
40020746.content: दर्शनादेव merely by seeing, यः who, प्राणान् lives, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपकर्षति draws away, किं what, पुनः moreover, स्पृश्यमानस्य of one being touched, पात्यमानस्य of one being struck down, वा or, पुनः again.

40020746.author: Translation
40020746.content: What more can be said of one who is touched or struck down, when merely by sight it draws away the lives of living beings?

40020747.author: पदार्थः
40020747.content: स that, ज्वालापरिवारस्तु surrounded by flames, निर्दहन्निव as if burning, राक्षसम् the demon, तेन by him, स्पृष्टो touched, बलवता by the powerful one, महाप्रहरणो the great weapon, अस्फुरत् trembled.

40020747.author: Translation
40020747.content: That great weapon, surrounded by flames as if burning the demon, trembled when touched by the powerful Yama.

40020748.author: पदार्थः
40020748.content: ततो then, विदुद्रुवुः fled, सर्वे all, तस्मात् from that, त्रस्ता terrified, रणाजिरे on the battlefield, सुराश्च and the gods, क्षुभिताः agitated, सर्वे all, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दण्डोद्यतं with the mace raised, यमम् Yama.

40020748.author: Translation
40020748.content: Then all those on the battlefield, terrified by that, fled, and all the gods were agitated upon seeing Yama with his mace raised.

40020749.author: पदार्थः
40020749.content: तस्मिन् when that, प्रहर्तुकामे desirous of striking, तु indeed, यमे Yama, दण्डेन with the mace, रावणम् Ravana, यमं to Yama, पितामहः the grandfather (Brahma), साक्षात् directly, दर्शयित्वा having appeared, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020749.author: Translation
40020749.content: When Yama was indeed desirous of striking Ravana with his mace, the grandfather Brahma directly appeared before Yama and spoke these words.

40020750.author: पदार्थः
40020750.content: वैवस्वत O son of Vivasvat, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, खलु indeed, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable prowess, न not, हन्तव्यः to be killed, त्वया by you, तेन by that, दण्डेनैव by the staff alone, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (demon).

40020750.author: Translation
40020750.content: O mighty-armed Yama, son of Vivasvat, you of immeasurable prowess, indeed that demon should not be killed by your staff alone.

40020751.author: पदार्थः
40020751.content: वरः a boon, खलु indeed, मया by me, एतस्मै to him, दत्तः given, त्रिदशपुङ्गव O chief among gods, सः that, त्वया by you, न not, अनृतः false, कार्यः to be made, यत् which, मया by me, व्याहृतं spoken, वचः word.

40020751.author: Translation
40020751.content: O chief among gods, indeed a boon has been given by me to him, and that word spoken by me should not be made false by you.

40020752.author: पदार्थः
40020752.content: यः whoever, हि indeed, माम् me, अनृतं false, कुर्यात् would make, देवः a god, वा or, मानुषः a human, अपि even, वा or, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अनृतं false, तेन by him, कृतं made, स्यात् would be, न not, अत्र here, संशयः doubt.

40020752.author: Translation
40020752.content: Whoever, be it a god or even a human, would make my word false, by him the three worlds would indeed be made false, there is no doubt about this.

40020753.author: पदार्थः
40020753.content: क्रुद्धेन by the angry one, विप्रमुक्तः released, अयम् this, निर्विशेषं without distinction, प्रियाप्रिये between dear and not dear, प्रजाः creatures, संहरते destroys, रौद्रः terrible, लोकत्रयभयावहः causing fear to the three worlds.

40020753.author: Translation
40020753.content: This terrible staff, when released by an angry one, destroys creatures without distinction between dear and not dear, causing fear to all three worlds.

40020754.author: पदार्थः
40020754.content: अमोघः unfailing, हि indeed, एषः this, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनाम् living beings, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable power, कालदण्डः the staff of time/death, मया by me, सृष्टः created, पूर्वं formerly, मृत्युपुरस्कृतः preceded by Death.

40020754.author: Translation
40020754.content: Indeed, this unfailing staff of Time, of immeasurable power for all living beings, was created by me long ago, with Death as its foremost aspect.

40020755.author: पदार्थः
40020755.content: तत् that, न not, खलु indeed, एष this, ते by you, सौम्य O gentle one, पात्यो to be cast, रावणमूर्धनि on Ravana's head । नहि indeed not, अस्मिन् on this, पतिते having fallen, कश्चित् anyone, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवति lives ।।

40020755.author: Translation
40020755.content: O gentle one (Yama), this rod of yours should certainly not be cast upon Ravana's head, for indeed, no one survives even for a moment once this rod has fallen.

40020756.author: पदार्थः
40020756.content: यदि if, हि indeed, अस्मिन् on this, निपतिते having fallen, न not, म्रियेत dies, एष this, राक्षसः demon । म्रियते dies, वा or, दशग्रीवः Ravana, तदापि then even, उभयतो from both sides, अनृतम् untruth ।।

40020756.author: Translation
40020756.content: If this demon (Ravana) does not die even after this rod has fallen, or if Ravana dies, then in either case, it would be a falsehood (regarding the boon of immortality).

40020757.author: पदार्थः
40020757.content: तत् therefore, निवर्तय withdraw, लङ्केशं from Ravana, दण्डम् rod, एतम् this, समुद्यतम् uplifted । सत्यं true, च and, मां me, कुरुष्व make, अद्य now, लोकान् worlds, त्वं you, यदि if, अवेक्षसे regard ।।

40020757.author: Translation
40020757.content: Therefore, withdraw this uplifted rod from Ravana and make my words true now, if you indeed care for the worlds.

40020758.author: पदार्थः
40020758.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, प्रत्युवाच replied, यमः Yama, तदा then । एष this, व्यावर्तितः withdrawn, दण्डः rod, प्रभविष्णुः powerful lord, हि indeed, नः our, भवान् you ।।

40020758.author: Translation
40020758.content: Thus spoken to, the righteous Yama then replied, "This rod has been withdrawn, for indeed, you are our powerful lord."

40020759.author: पदार्थः
40020759.content: किं नु what indeed, इदानीं now, मया by me, शक्यं possible, कर्तुं to do, रणगतेन having gone to battle, हि indeed । न not, मया by me, यदि if, अयम् this, शक्यः possible, हन्तुं to kill, वरपुरस्कृतः protected by a boon ।।

40020759.author: Translation
40020759.content: What indeed can I do now, having come to battle, if this one (Ravana) cannot be killed by me because he is protected by a boon?

40020760.author: पदार्थः
40020760.content: एष this, तस्मात् therefore, प्रणश्यामि I disappear, दर्शनात् from the sight, अस्य of this, रक्षसः demon, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सरथः with his chariot, साश्वः with his horses, तत्रैव right there, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

40020760.author: Translation
40020760.content: Having said, "Therefore, I disappear from the sight of this demon," he vanished right there with his chariot and horses.

40020761.author: पदार्थः
40020761.content: दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तु and, तम् him, जित्वा having conquered, नाम name, विश्राव्य having proclaimed, च and, आत्मनः his own, आरुह्य having ascended, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, भूयः again, निष्क्रान्तः departed, यमसादनात् from Yama's abode.

40020761.author: Translation
40020761.content: Dashagriva, having conquered him and proclaimed his own name, ascended the Pushpaka chariot again and departed from Yama's abode.

40020762.author: पदार्थः
40020762.content: सः he, तु and, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata (Yama), देवैः with the gods, सह together, ब्रह्मपुरोगमैः with Brahma as their leader, जगाम went, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, हृष्टः delighted, नारदः Narada, च and, महामुनिः the great sage.

40020762.author: Translation
40020762.content: And Vaivasvata (Yama), delighted, went to heaven along with the gods led by Brahma, as did the great sage Narada. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्वाविंशः सर्गः ।। 22 ।। Thus ends the twenty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
